run_update_failure_list_add: run the script to add new test failures to a protobuf conformance failure list file
run_update_failure_list_remove: run the script to remove test failures from a protobuf conformance failure list file
run_update_failure_list_align: run the script to align failure messages in a protobuf conformance failure list to column 114
run_update_failure_list_lexsort: run the script to insert new failures in lexicographical order into an existing sorted failure list
run_update_failure_list_conflict: run the script to detect and raise an error when the same test is in both add and remove lists
